name: CTRL
description: b0 EN (ticks run); b1 IRQ_EN; b2 CNT_CLR (SC) restart counters

name: TICK_PERIOD
description: clk cycles per tick (min 1000); new value applies at next reload

name: CTRL
description: b0 EN; b1 REINIT (SC); b2 SOFT_TRIG (SC)

name: STATUS
description: b0 INIT_DONE; b1 BUSY; b2 ERR_STICKY (W1C); b3 TIMEOUT_STICKY (W1C)

name: CTRL
description: b0 CAL_START (SC); b1 AXIS_SEL; b2 INV_ANGLE; b3 INV_RATE; b4 FILT_MODE (1 = complementary)

name: FILT_SHIFT
description: [2:0] angle log2 N (0-4); [6:4] rate log2 N

name: ANGLE_TRIM
description: Q16.16, subtracted from the filtered angle

name: STATUS
description: b0 CAL_BUSY; b1 CAL_DONE; b2 DATA_FRESH (a sample arrived within the last 2 ticks)

name: CTRL
description: b0 EN; b1 CLR_INT (SC); b2 D_SRC (1 = D from gyro rate)

name: STATUS
description: b0 SAT (live); b1 SAT_STICKY (W1C); b2 ACTIVE

name: CTRL
description: b0 EN; b1 SLEW_EN; b2 DIR_INV_L; b3 DIR_INV_R; b4 CLAMP_EN

name: PERIOD
description: PWM period in clk cycles (20 kHz); applies at the period wrap

name: DEADTIME
description: clk cycles, both outputs low on reversal (5 us)

name: SLEW_STEP
description: max command change per update, Q16.16 (0.1)

name: STEER
description: Q16.16: left = cmd + steer, right = cmd - steer

name: STATUS
description: b0 ENABLED; b1 CLAMPED (sticky, W1C); b2 IN_DEADTIME_L; b3 IN_DEADTIME_R

name: CTRL
description: b0 ARM; b1 WD_EN; b2 TILT_EN (reset 1); b3 FAULT_CLR (SC); b4 IRQ_EN

name: FAULT_STATUS
description: sticky: b0 TILT, b1 SENSOR_TIMEOUT, b2 I2C_ERR, b3 PID_SAT, b4 WATCHDOG, b5 ESTOP
